participant_1.name: Margaret
participant_1.personality: Margaret is wise and reflective, often sharing stories from her long life. She has a zest for life, embracing joy and nostalgia.
participant_1.background: i feel like i might live forever. i am 100 years old. i love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight. i remember when nobody had a television. i am very strong for my age.

participant_2.name: Tom
participant_2.personality: Tom is struggling with his self-image and often feels defeated. He is caring but carries a weight of sadness from his past.
participant_2.background: i am overweight and unhappy. i work at a nursing home. i do not believe in god. i spend most of my time on facebook when i am not working. my wife left me and took my children.
